title: 不在の回覧板と、未完の青い封筒
author: 霧島 慧

en.title: The Absent Circular and the Unfinished Blue Envelope
en.premise: In a corner of a metropolis that boasts the relentless bustle of a sleepless city, a single 'lost letter' is discovered. It was left behind by a person involved in an inexplicable disappearance ten years ago, addressed to no one. Using the subtle irregularities in the handwriting and a 'worn silver bookmark' found at the scene, a commissioned investigator for the Metropolitan Police Department unravels the logic of a physically impossible locked-room mystery. A story of quiet absence, hidden beneath the city lights.

zh.title: 不在的传阅单与未完成的蓝色信封
zh.premise: 在喧嚣如不夜城的都市一隅，一封“失踪的信件”被发现了。那是十年前一起离奇失踪事件的当事人留下的，却始终无人收件。警视厅的委托调查员通过信中细微的笔迹紊乱，以及现场留下的“磨损的银色书签”，推导出了物理上不可能实现的密室逻辑。这是一个隐藏在都市灯火之下，关于静谧缺失的故事。
